hero_sub: Text + reference images → a verified, exportable 3D model (STEP, STL, 3MF, DXF) for 3D printing and CNC.
discard_draft_confirm: Delete the empty draft project? It has no versions yet.
prompt_hint: Shape, dimensions (X length × Y width × Z height, mm), holes, threads, tolerances, material and process. The agent will measure, plan, generate and verify a parametric 3D model.
prompt_placeholder: e.g. Mounting plate 80×60×8mm, four M4 clearance holes at 10mm from corners, countersunk, PLA for FDM.
ex_1: Mounting plate 80×60×8mm, four M4 clearance holes 10mm from the corners, countersunk, PLA for FDM.
ex_2: Desk cable clip, 40mm wide, snap-fit spring tab, PETG.
ex_3: Organic drawer knob, rounded pebble shape, ~45mm diameter, M4 heat-set insert on the back.
ex_4: L-bracket 60×40×30mm, two M5 holes per leg, carries 200N vertical — topology-optimize to 40% volume.
images_hint: Photos, drawings or sketches help the agent understand the shape — or let a local image model generate a concept. Selected images feed the run.
mode_hint: How the agent should build the part. When unsure, keep Auto or the recommended mode.
mode_auto_desc: Recommended default — CAD for technical parts, mesh/hybrid for organic shapes.
mode_cad_desc: Precise, dimension-true parts: plates, brackets, enclosures, standard fasteners.
mode_mesh_desc: Organic / sculptural shapes from reference images. Needs ≥1 image + mesh server.
mode_hybrid_desc: Generated organic body with precise bores, threads and inserts on top.
mode_topopt_desc: CAD base part, then SIMP-optimized lightweight structure, FEM-verified.
no_images_warn: no reference images selected — the run will fall back to CAD.
topopt_hint: describe loads & fixtures in the prompt (e.g. "fixed at the holes, 100 N on top") — the agent picks the base geometry, then optimizes it.
review_hint: The project is created automatically — adjust the name, set run options, then start.
no_llm_warn: No LLM provider is configured — generation will fail. Check Settings → provider first.
prog_hint: The agent is iterating: plan → code → execute → measure → critique. Answer any questions below — you can leave this page and come back via Jobs.
prog_done_hint: The model was generated and verified. Open the result for the 3D viewer, exports, quality report and edits.
prog_failed_msg: The job did not produce a verified result.
